title: AgentArmyPowerTemplate Agent Frontmatter Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating the YAML frontmatter of AgentArmyPowerTemplate agent definition files (.claude/agents/categories/**/*.md). Compatible with AJV and any draft-07 JSON Schema validator.

name.description: Unique kebab-case agent identifier. Convention: <role>-<specialty> or <domain>-<function>.

description.description: Single-sentence routing trigger. Must start with 'Use this agent when' or 'Use when'. This is what Claude Code matches to auto-route tasks.
examples: Use this agent when designing new APIs, creating API specifications, or refactoring existing API architecture.

tools.description: Comma-separated list of tools the agent is permitted to use. Only request what the agent actually needs.
examples: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

model.description: Claude model tier. sonnet=implementation/design, opus=complex reasoning/architecture, haiku=lightweight/routing.

category.description: The category directory this agent is filed under. Must match one of the 11 canonical category IDs.

primary_skills.description: 3-5 concise capability labels for this agent. Used by the capability matrix and audit tooling to detect MECE gaps and overlaps.

routing_conditions.description: Human-readable list of specific task triggers for when to invoke this agent. More granular than the top-level description field.

routing_anti_patterns.description: Explicit list of tasks this agent does NOT handle, each with the alternative agent to route to. Supports MECE boundary rules.

prerequisites.description: Agents or context that should be available before invoking this agent. Use agent names when a prior agent output is expected.

escalates_to.description: Agent(s) this agent escalates edge cases to. Should always include error-coordinator unless this agent IS error-coordinator.

known_limits.description: Explicit failure modes and capability boundaries. Surfaced in the capability matrix to help users pick the right agent.

example_prompts.description: 2-3 concrete, copy-paste-ready invocation examples for this agent.

known_tools.description: Reference list of known tool identifiers (not enforced by schema - used by audit tooling).

model_tiers.description: Model tier guidance (normative, not enforced by schema - enforced by audit tooling heuristics).

opus.description: Complex reasoning: architecture, security audits, strategy, cross-service orchestration.

sonnet.description: Implementation, design, multi-step problem-solving. Default for most specialist agents.

haiku.description: Lightweight tasks, simple routing, fast responses. Use when the task is narrowly scoped.
